item.title: US Vice President meets Qatar’s Prime Minister on Iran negotiations
item.description:
US Vice President JD Vance met Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al-Thani at the White House on Monday, according to the Associated Press. Qatar is playing a key role in reviving stalled negotiations to end the US-Iran war. Mediators are pushing a proposal to lift disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for limited sanctions relief for Tehran.
Sources: ClickOrlando (AP) https://www.clickorlando.com/news/politics/2026/11/24/vance-and-rubio-meet-with-qatari-pm-as-uncertainty-mounts-over-trumps-intentions-with-iran/ · Kotak Neo https://www.kotakneo.com/news/commodities/oil-price-today-24-november-2026-brent-falls-below-90-us-iran-talks-supply-risks/ · News Tunisia https://news-tunisia.tunisienumerique.com/oil-prices-brent-falls-below-89-hitting-a-three-month-low/

item.title: Qatar and US review Gaza, Syria, Lebanon and Iran in regional session
item.description:
Qatar and the United States held a session on regional and international affairs in Washington as part of the eighth Strategic Dialogue, chaired on the Qatari side by Minister of State at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Dr Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Al Khulaifi. Assistant Secretary of State for Near Eastern Affairs Donald Blome chaired the US side. The session covered developments in the Gaza Strip, Syria, Lebanon and Iran and efforts to de-escalate regional tensions.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266188/latest-news/qatar-us-hold-session-on-regional-international-affairs-as-part-of-8th-round-of-strategic-dialogue · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738901/qatar/qatar-us-hold-session-on-regional-international-affairs-as-part-of-8th-round-of-strategic-dialogue

item.title: Qatari Diar: over 800 villas under construction at Huzoom Lusail
item.description:
Qatari Diar Real Estate Investment Company said more than 800 villas are under construction at Huzoom Lusail and that occupancy at The Seef has passed 150 residential units. Huzoom comprises 2,883 villa plots of 400 to 800 square metres. Infrastructure for its first two phases is complete, and the third phase is expected to be finished in 2028.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/qatari-diar-over-800-villas-under-construction-at-huzoom-lusail-150-residential-units-occupied-at-the-seef · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266085/business/qatari-diar-reports-progress-at-huzoom-lusail-and-the-seef

item.title: Invest Qatar partners with Builders VC to attract tech companies
item.description:
Investment promotion agency Invest Qatar announced a strategic partnership with venture capital firm Builders VC, backed by the Qatar Investment Authority’s Fund of Funds. The agency will provide Builders VC portfolio companies with end-to-end support to enter the Qatari market and establish their businesses. Builders VC will promote Qatar across its global network and refer interested founders.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/invest-qatar-builders-vc-partner-to-connect-high-growth-technology-companies-with-opportunities-in-qatar · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266038/business/qatar-ties-up-with-builders-vc-to-attract-global-startups

item.title: Doha to host the 2028 FIVB World Congress
item.description:
The International Volleyball Federation chose Doha to host its 2028 World Congress, announced at its 40th Congress in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, on 22 November. The congress comes a year before Qatar hosts the 2029 Men’s World Championship. Qatar Olympic Committee Secretary General Jassim bin Rashid Al Buenain welcomed the decision.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/doha-to-host-2028-fivb-world-congress-ahead-of-2029-world-championship · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266071/sports/doha-to-host-2028-fivb-world-congress-ahead-of-2029-mens-cship

item.title: Al Sadd face Al Nassr in Riyadh to save Asian campaign
item.description:
Al Sadd visit Saudi side Al Nassr in Riyadh today, Tuesday, in the AFC Champions League Elite with only two points from four matches. The Qatari champions need a positive result to keep their qualification hopes alive. Al Sadd have failed to score in three of their last four matches in the competition.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/al-sadd-seek-lifeline-against-al-nassr · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266076/sports/al-sadd-face-al-nassr-in-riyadh-today-keen-to-revive-campaign

item.title: Qatar swimmers win 37 medals at fifth Arab Aquatics Championships
item.description:
Qatar’s swimming team finished the fifth Arab Aquatics Championships in Manama with 37 medals, including 21 golds, placing first in the open category and second overall, according to Al Raya. Qatari swimmers set 16 Arab records. On the final day they won five golds and two silvers.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%B7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/qatar-clinch-seven-medals-at-arab-aquatics-championships

item.title: IRGC says three tankers caught fire after hitting mines in Hormuz
item.description:
The navy of Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps said on Tuesday that three oil tankers suffered explosions and fires after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. The claim has not been independently verified, and the Joint Maritime Information Center logs “unknown projectiles”. The centre keeps the threat level at “severe”, with traffic 65% below pre-war levels.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/24/iran-war-live-iran-says-three-ships-catch-fire-after-hitting-hormuz-mines · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/mid-east-war-what-irgc-claimed-what-jmic-reported-what-residents-need-to-know-today-nov-24-2026-1.500758721

item.title: Eleven killed in bus and lorry collision in Ras Al Khaimah
item.description:
Eleven people were killed when a passenger bus and a lorry collided on Al Watan Road in Ras Al Khaimah, the UAE interior ministry said on Tuesday. Ambulance and civil defence teams responded, and authorities opened an investigation into the cause. The crash follows a pile-up in Fujairah on 12 November that killed 14 people.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/24/11-killed-in-passenger-bus-and-truck-collision-in-ras-al-khaimah/ · Oman Observer (Reuters) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200158/world/region/bus-truck-collision-kills-11-in-ras-al-khaimah

item.title: Kuwait ratifies the unified GCC excise tax agreement
item.description:
Kuwait’s Amir Sheikh Meshal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah issued Decree-Law No. 140 of 2026 approving the Unified Excise Tax Agreement of the Gulf Cooperation Council and its amendment annex. The agreement was signed in Riyadh on 27 November 2016 and the annex on 1 June 2025. The decree takes effect on publication in the official gazette.
Sources: Kuwait Times https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54248/kuwait/kuwait-approves-gcc-excise-tax-agreement-by-decree/ · Al-Seyassah https://alseyassah.com/article/475747/

item.title: Fifteen injured as vehicle collides with school bus in Muscat
item.description:
Fifteen people suffered moderate to serious injuries when a vehicle and a school bus collided on an internal road in Al Maabilah, Wilayat of Seeb, according to the Royal Oman Police. Specialised teams took the injured to a healthcare facility for treatment.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200155/oman/rop/15-injured-in-school-bus-collision-in-muscat · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179537-15-injured-in-vehicle-school-bus-collision-in-al-maabilah

item.title: Brent slips to $88.97, near a three-month low
item.description:
Brent futures fell 40 cents to $88.97 a barrel in Asian trading on Tuesday, after Monday’s settlement at the lowest level since 31 August. US crude slipped to $79.94. Prices are weighed down by hopes of a Washington-Tehran deal and oversupply concerns, while Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent forecast to $105.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/oil-prices-slide-on-oversupply-concerns · Kotak Neo https://www.kotakneo.com/news/commodities/oil-price-today-24-november-2026-brent-falls-below-90-us-iran-talks-supply-risks/ · News Tunisia https://news-tunisia.tunisienumerique.com/oil-prices-brent-falls-below-89-hitting-a-three-month-low/

item.title: Abdelatty discusses Libya and Sudan with US adviser Boulos
item.description:
Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty discussed by phone on Tuesday with Massad Boulos, senior adviser to the US President for Arab and African affairs, developments in Libya after the attacks on Benghazi port. Abdelatty stressed the priority of Libya’s unity and sovereignty and a Libyan-owned and Libyan-led political settlement. The call also covered developments in Sudan.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534885 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192470

item.title: Planning minister: economic transformation programme targets 3 million jobs
item.description:
Planning and Economic Development Minister Ahmed Rostom said on Tuesday that the national economic transformation programme aims to create 3 million new jobs. He spoke at the national forum on employment and the labour market organised by the American University in Cairo. He said the government is working to raise private-sector investment as the main driver of growth.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192476 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534882

item.title: Part of a building collapses in Alexandria’s Attarine district
item.description:
Part of a building collapsed on a street off Imam Malik Street in Alexandria’s central Attarine district on Tuesday morning. Civil defence recovered a woman’s body and four people were injured, according to Cairo 24, while Youm7 reported the deaths of a mother and her two daughters under the rubble. Governor Ayman Attia followed the rescue work, and prosecutors opened an investigation.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534900 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/%D9%85%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%B3%D9%83%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%AF-%D9%82%D8%A8%D9%84-%D8%B2%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%81%D9%87%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B9-%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%A7-%D9%85%D9%86/7630351

item.title: Twenty-two workers injured as two buses collide near Dabaa
item.description:
Twenty-two people were injured on Tuesday morning when two buses carrying workers collided on the coastal road at kilometre 106, at the entrance to Dabaa in Matrouh governorate. The injured were taken to Dabaa Central Hospital for treatment.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192506 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534894

item.title: Egyptian bourse gains EGP50bn at the open
item.description:
The benchmark EGX30 rose 1.27% to 51,358 points at the open on Tuesday, and the EGX70 gained 1.84%. Market capitalisation rose by about EGP50.4bn to EGP4.047tn.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534896 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/51-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%87-%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8B-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%86%D8%B5%D9%81-%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%B5%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%B7%D9%89-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AC%D8%B2/7630359

item.title: Dollar eases 6 piastres to EGP54.33 at National Bank of Egypt
item.description:
The dollar fell 6 piastres at National Bank of Egypt at the start of trading on Tuesday to EGP54.23 buying and EGP54.33 selling. At Banque Misr it fell 15 piastres to EGP54.25 selling, while other banks held it at EGP54.39 selling.
Sources: Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=24112026&id=da66d5dd-c1fa-477b-be34-5ae002688db9 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news-banking/details/2026/11/24/3083616/%D8%B3%D8%B9%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D8%AA

item.title: 21-carat gold holds at EGP5,700 after Monday’s jump
item.description:
The price of 21-carat gold held at EGP5,700 a gram selling on Tuesday, after rising EGP135 at Monday’s close. 24-carat gold stood at about EGP6,514, and the gold pound at EGP45,600.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192115 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534850

item.title: Madbouly to launch local production of Chevrolet Groove tomorrow
item.description:
Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly will attend the launch of local manufacturing of the Chevrolet Groove at the General Motors plant in 6th of October City tomorrow, Wednesday. On the same day he will hold a news conference in the New Capital to announce amendments to the executive regulations of Companies Law No. 159.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%AF-%D8%BA%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D8%A5%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B5%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%84%D9%8A-%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D9%8A%D9%81%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%87/7630335 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534893 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192497

item.title: Sheikh Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh on 16 December
item.description:
A spokesperson for former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said on Tuesday she plans to return from exile in India on 16 December, the anniversary of victory in the 1971 war. She urged the Dhaka government to arrange her return on the national carrier. The government says she can only return through extradition, after a court sentenced her to death in absentia.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/sheikh-hasina-plans-to-return-to-bangladesh-from-exile-on-december-16 · Times of Oman (Reuters) https://timesofoman.com/article/179533-sheikh-hasina-plans-bangladesh-return-on-december-16-seeks-government-arranged-flight-report

item.title: WFP: Hormuz, Bab al-Mandeb and Black Sea chokepoints threaten food aid
item.description:
WFP Executive Director Luke Lindberg warned the Security Council on Monday that disruption in the Strait of Hormuz, the Bab al-Mandeb and the Black Sea has raised food and humanitarian costs. The agency expects $727m in additional costs by mid-2027 if conditions persist, putting assistance for 7.3 million people at risk.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/wars-choke-global-food-routes-threatening-aid-for-7-3-million-wfp-warns · UN News https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/11/1168859

item.title: Australia moves to fine platforms up to 5% of global revenue
item.description:
Australia’s government reached a deal with the Greens on Tuesday to pass its digital duty of care law through the Senate this week. The law would fine tech companies up to 5% of global revenue if they fail to remove harmful content. It also gives individuals the right to sue platforms for harm they suffer.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/australia-warns-tech-giants-of-multibillion-dollar-fines-for-online-harm · ABC News (Australia) https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-24/federal-politics-labor-makes-deal-greens-on-digital-duty-of-care/107420982

item.title: Russia says it struck energy sites and a cargo ship near Odesa
item.description:
Russia’s Defence Ministry said on Tuesday its forces struck overnight a dry cargo ship it said was carrying military cargo south-west of Odesa. It said its drones hit energy and fuel facilities, including a 110-kilovolt power station in Pryluky in the Chernihiv region.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/ar-QA/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%81%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D8%AD%D9%86-%D9%88%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%83%D8%B2-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534838

item.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler in $43.9bn deal
item.description:
CrowdStrike and Zscaler announced on Monday a definitive agreement under which CrowdStrike will acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at $43.9bn, the largest cybersecurity acquisition on record. Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares for each share. The combined company expects more than $10bn in annual recurring revenue.
Sources: CrowdStrike-Zscaler release (SEC filing) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001713683/000119312526471211/d115803dex991.htm · Gulf Times (Reuters) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738849/business/crowdstrike-snaps-up-zscaler-in-44bn-deal-as-cyber-threats-mount
